evidence.audit_scope: all accepted synchronized runs, including frames excluded by later curation

lane.purpose: Backward-compatible binary lane-boundary target; excludes stopline

drivable.ab_role: A baseline; actor-negative free-space policy is a separate future variant

stopline.purpose: Backward-compatible binary target and all-view QA

actor_occupancy_gt.purpose: Drivable A/B evaluation and future camera-LiDAR fusion evaluation

class_notes.background: Head-local road-marking background: every valid pixel that is not white_lane, yellow_lane, or stopline.
class_notes.blue_lane: Zero pixels in the full accepted-run audit. It is excluded from competition targets and baking fails if it appears later.
class_notes.stopline: Positive in all three views; all-view supervision is retained for later calibrated BEV fusion.
class_notes.standing_object: Permanent roadside/tunnel structures; keep as non-road background, not transient actor occupancy.
class_notes.obstacle: Spawned cones and hazard/fire props; retain in actor occupancy and drivable-ignore baseline.
class_notes.ego_vehicle: Visible ego hood/body is non-road background, not actor ignore.

palette_source: MORAI 26.R1 Semantic camera official RGB palette encoded in data_collection.mask_baker.OFFICIAL_PALETTE_RGB
